address: 536 E. 5th St., New York, NY, 10009, USA
bio: From the team behind Odo comes an izakaya that is casual in concept but serious in execution. A handful of bar seats overlook a minuscule kitchen that’s constantly in motion. The space is cozy, nothing more than a rustic wood counter and exposed red brick. The menu, meanwhile, offers an assortment of light starters and sashimi, grilled fish and wagyu, and other specialties that are fried, simmered or served over rice. This is food to be shared, and past highlights include charcoal-kissed mackerel with ponzu as well as dashi egg with rice, Hokkaido uni and seaweed. Best suited for couples, the experience is leisurely and intentional.
